purpose: Blind second reading: which substances EU law brings into the definition of drug through the Annex of Council Framework Decision 2004/757/JHA, and by which acts. Report what each source prints.

UK_2017_2103_ANNEX.ask: Heading of the Annex; every substance it names, numbered as printed (short names). Also the full title and date of Directive (EU) 2017/2103 if the page gives them.

COM_2022_251.ask: What the document is (number, date); every Commission delegated directive it lists that amended the Annex, with the directive number, its date, and the substances it added; any directive still in its scrutiny period, with its number as printed.

EUDA_NEWS_2026.ask: Date of the news item; which substances; which act (number, date); when it entered into force; the deadline for Member States.

EUDA_LIB_2022.ask: The act number and date as printed, the substances it concerns, and any publication reference (Official Journal number and date).

EURLEX_2025_2062.ask: Title, number, date, date of entry into force (metadata only is expected).
